architectureInvariants.serviceOwnership: Zenod owns memory, tenant Google Drive custody and the application receipt; Phylax owns channel transport, raw staging, transcription and provider delivery.
architectureInvariants.runtimeBoundary: Zenod and Phylax remain independently deployed services with independent stores, credentials, sessions and volumes.
architectureInvariants.browserBoundary: The browser talks only to its product backend; tenant-scoped backend calls cross the Phylax MCP boundary.
architectureInvariants.identityContinuity: Ordinary startup, reconciliation and image rollout do not rotate, revoke, replace or reinterpret MCP credentials, OAuth clients, tenant Google credentials, channel sessions, tenant bindings or volumes.
architectureInvariants.captureRule: One provider message creates one durable job and at most one terminal customer receipt; raw evidence is journaled before optional paid processing.
architectureInvariants.voiceRule: Voice notes up to and including two hours transcribe automatically; longer notes archive raw audio without transcription and create a pointer entry.
architectureInvariants.architectureAuthority: A ticket may characterize these behaviors but may not redesign service ownership, auth, routing, metering or customer experience.
